fact: On 6 June 2025 the Ministry of Health, Social Welfare and Health Infrastructure officially launched Guinea Salud, an AI chatbot for the public on vaccination, medical evacuation, clinic and pharmacy licensing and HIV, in pilot phase with MCD Global Health.
title: Sanidad lanza "Guinea Salud", primer asistente digital con IA en Guinea Ecuatorial
publisher: Guinea Salud (Ministerio de Sanidad, Bienestar Social e Infraestructuras Sanitarias)
